_doc: Time of day (render/daylight.gd, Roadcraft render/scene.ts): shadow_bias_m: the depth bias along the light in the first cascade, in metres, and shadow_normal_bias the offset along the normal, in texels, by the rule of the 4.0: a few centimetres and the rest along the normal. The engine (tag 4.7.2-stable, light_storage.cpp, renderer_scene_cull.cpp) takes bias / 100 x (2 radius + pancake) x blur x filter radius for each cascade, so the bias in metres holds for the first cascade and the others grow with theirs, the same in texels. Godot master clamps blur x filter radius to at least 1 here and the tag does not: look again when the engine moves on. shadow_pancake_m: the DirectionalLight3D default. the normal offset goes by 1 - n.l. 2.5: roofs clean of acne on the same buildings as the 4.0 at 16h (ports/landscape/evidence/par4_h); a modelling choice, measured at 1, 2.5 and 4.7 before the cascades were fitted right and checked at 2.5 after. ground_under, ground_under_k: what a surface facing straight down loses of the flat ambient, per channel. A modelling choice from the ratio of the ground colour to the half sum of sky and ground in a hemisphere light (the 4.0 uses #e6e4da over #6a6b4c: 0.31, 0.32, 0.19 of the ambient left), not yet held to a photo. hours, sun/moon arc in degrees, light colours (sRGB) and Godot energies. sun_energy and the day ambient: the sun at the surface is about 98 000 lx (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sunlight); energy 0.89 stands for that, a unit of 110 klx: painted discs of the same albedo in both games, sun at 29 degrees, gave 1.63, 1.72 and 1.82 per albedo (R, G, B) at the curve in the 4.0 (ports/landscape/plano.md). hemi_day, hemi_day_k: the flat light every face gets. sky_top, sky_top_energy: what the sky adds to what faces up, so a shaded wall and a shaded street differ, as the hemisphere light and sky map of the 4.0. Both measured on a grey box of albedo 0.216 in both games, sun at 29 degrees, face by face in the linear of the tone chain (ports/landscape/relatorio.md); fill_energy from the same box. shadow_bias: the Godot default for a directional light; 0.02 striped the plain roofs. shadow_past_look, shadow_first_past_look, shadow_first_share: the cascades of the 4.0 (sunCascades.ts) after Engel, ShaderX5, modelling choices; shadow_first_least_m and shadow_view_least_dip: a street-level view, measured on a sign post by the street furniture port. sun_low: near white at noon, warmer low (4.0 linear (1, 0.96, 0.9) and (1, 0.84, 0.62) written in sRGB); moon, moon_energy, hemi_night and hemi_night_k: faces of a grey box of albedo 0.216 at 22:00 in both games, in the linear of the tone chain, the day ratio of light to linear (0.61) turned back to energy: the three channels of the moon give the same 0.224 (ports/landscape/plano-noite.json); moon_elev_deg and moon_az_deg: the moon stands fixed, high over the east of the sky, as the 4.0 keeps it (a modelling choice), sky gradient, fog, shadows, tone mapping. awake_by_hour: the share of people not asleep at each hour from midnight, 100 % less the Sleeping row of BLS American Time Use Survey Table A-3 (2007-11, https://www.bls.gov/tus/tables/a3_0711.pdf): the rooms lit at night. room_daylight: how bright a room seen through its glass is by day. outside_all_night: the outside lights left on all night.

grade._doc: Film grade of the picture on screen (render/film_grade.cpp), read in the display image. The four numbers are a modelling choice, the 4.0's own look; the photos of painted discs of known albedo prove it is there: x = 2.4 albedo - 0.25 through the plain ACES (ports/landscape/evidence/luz).

vignette._doc: How the picture falls off to the corners (render/shaders/vignette.gdshader), a modelling choice, the 4.0's own look.

occlusion._doc: Screen-space occlusion of the high presets (render/shaders/occlusion.gdshader): the 4.0's GTAO, blended over the whole picture. Its radius 1 reached by a random share of 0.5 to 1 of it; a fixed set of slices takes the mean. Its distance exponent, thickness, scale and intensity, the values modelling choices.
